```python
def build_remediation_info_url(base_url: str, version: Optional[str], spec: str, target_version: Optional[str]='') ->str:
    if version and target_version:
        separator = '&' if '?' in base_url else '?'
        return f"{base_url}{separator}from={version}&to={target_version}"
    return base_url
```
